# Tight coupling to IR vocabulary counts

The test enforces exact counts of entity and relation types. Adding or removing types will fail tests, making vocabulary evolution potentially costly and error-prone.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_smoke.py` — `tests.test_smoke.test_vocabulary_matches_ir_spec`
